bead.title: Relational family rebuild-from-log migration (ADR-013)
bead.description: ADR-013: the relational projection (pqueue_items and peers) is a materialized cache, not authoritative. Rework the Postgres/sqlite relational backends so recovery_high_water returns the applied position and replays the log tail (today relational.rs returns 'nothing to replay'); persist the applied-high-water; make projection tables truncatable and rebuildable from the persisted command log (genesis or snapshot). Verify the closed TOCTOU bead pqueue-b59f4897 (MAX(seq)+1 append allocation under pooling) actually holds multi-node before relying on the append seam as sole serialization point — ADR-013 names it a hard prerequisite. Retire 'DB-authoritative' language from relational.rs doc comments. Relational backends then join the 'log' conformance class per TD-001.
bead.acceptance: Truncate-projection-then-recover test reproduces exact acknowledged state (items, leases, counters, idempotency, fences, metrics) on postgres and sqlite relational; recovery_high_water + tail replay wired through ComposedBackend::recover; log conformance class green on the relational family; multi-node TOCTOU regression test referenced/green; 'authoritative' wording removed from relational module docs.
